description: Source code for the 'iron-iconset-svg' Polymer web component, which allows defining and managing SVG icon sets within a web project.

classes.name: iron-iconset-svg
classes.description: Custom Polymer element for managing SVG icon sets, including methods for applying, removing, and cloning icons.

methods.name: getIconNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all icon names in this iconset.

methods.name: applyIcon
methods.description: Applies an SVG icon to a specified element.

methods.name: removeIcon
methods.description: Removes an applied icon from a specified element.

methods.name: _nameChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the iconset's name property changes, registering metadata.

methods.name: _createIconMap
methods.description: Creates a map of icon IDs to SVG elements within the iconset.

methods.name: _cloneIcon
methods.description: Produces a clone of the SVG element for a given icon ID.

methods.name: _prepareSvgClone
methods.description: Prepares and returns a clone of an SVG element with specified size and viewBox.
